corpora: one approved V2 final per cohort, chosen by the sponsor before the run; its artifact key and master digest are recorded in the pilot dossier before any check

seeded_defects.rule: per cohort a seeded-defect copy of the clean package draft with these >= 6 defects, each in its own revision

defects.change: declare a thumbnail whose byte_size is off by one
check against a profile whose window excludes the master
title one character over the platform limit
insert a banned phrase into the description

reviewer.independence_limit: single reviewer; the reviewer also authored the brief and selects the package

seeded_recall.threshold: >= 6 of the 7 seeded defects caught per cohort (85.7%, preserving the design's >= 5/6 = 83.3%)
seeded_recall.record: caught/missed per defect id; false negatives listed

false_positives_on_clean.threshold: <= 1 per cohort as judged by the reviewer
false_positives_on_clean.record: every finding on the clean final with the reviewer's verdict

reviewer_disagreement.record: per finding: check verdict vs reviewer verdict

runtime_per_bundle_ms.record: export wall time from request to receipt

storage_bytes.record: archive byte size / master byte size

determinism.threshold: byte-identical archives from two clean roots
determinism.record: two independent project roots provisioned from the same frozen logical inputs (same master bytes, same package draft, same profile), each exported with its own command; both archive digests and byte sizes recorded and compared

smallest_useful_effect: seeded recall >= 6/7 in every cohort AND at least one of: a real defect caught on a clean final, or a correction made through the packaging page and re-checked to PASS; 'nothing found' on clean finals never satisfies the effect alone

runtime_network.experiment: inside one confined export unit (same launcher, SystemCallFilter ~@network-io, SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM) run a socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM) attempt and record errno EPERM, plus `systemctl --user show` unit properties
runtime_network.claim_scope: confined code only (export worker and probes); host check, rename and verification code are covered by the static scan, recorded as a limit

human_gates: publish the cohort's V2 quality profile (A3 custodian)
issue the disposition on the sealed run (A6 custodian)
agent_may_prepare: package drafts including the seeded-defect revisions
checks, previews and exports after the Human selection
agent_must_not: approve, waive, dispose or select on the sponsor's behalf

revision.reason: pre-run correction after independent review: recall threshold preserves design >=5/6; clean-root determinism and in-unit socket denial are explicit experiments

post_run_amendments.frozen_text: byte-identical archives from two clean roots
post_run_amendments.replacement: (a) a new export command for the same selection is byte-identical; (b) every content member is byte-identical across two independent clean roots from the same frozen logical inputs; manifest.json (per-root provenance) excluded
post_run_amendments.reason: the frozen wording contradicts the manifest's provenance binding required by design §3 recovery and offline verification
post_run_amendments.effect_on_recorded_runs: none: the 2026-10-29 runs stay recorded as failing the frozen wording
